practice.title: Art
practice.passage: Artwork can provide evidence about a place and time but does not represent everyone. Ask who made it, for whom, and why. Distinguish observation from historical inference.

items.prompt: Can one artwork represent an entire society?
items.answer: No; its context and limits matter.

practice.title: Life Sciences
practice.passage: Ethics considers how people ought to act. Equal shares and fair treatment are related but not identical; relevant needs and responsibilities can matter. Ethical questions may involve competing considerations.

items.prompt: Can equal treatment and fair treatment differ?
items.answer: Yes; relevant needs or circumstances can justify different support.
